summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Innovator 20+ Year Treasury Bond 5 Floor ETF - July (TFJL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to provide the price return of a long-term US Treasuries ETF, up to a cap, while minimizing the downside risk over a 3-month period. The actively-managed fund provides such exposure via FLEX options and collateral. TFJL was launched on Aug 18, 2020 and is issued by Innovator.
